column1: # THE MEDIA LIBRARY, ONE ROW PER FILE
# Generated by tools/media.py. Every column but the last is computed from the
# file, so nothing in it can quietly drift; tools/check.py C21 fails when it
# does. The caption is the one column written by hand, and it is carried over
# Rebuild after adding or removing media:   python3 tools/media.py scan
# Check without rewriting anything:         python3 tools/media.py verify
#   path      relative to the top of the repository
#   kind      photo, image, video, document or model
#   pixels    WIDTHxHEIGHT as stored, before any EXIF rotation is applied
#   captured  local time the shutter opened, or the recording started.
#             Blank where a file was made rather than shot.
#   made      local time THIS version was written, where that differs from the
#             capture: a photograph marked up afterwards, or an export that
#             carries no capture time at all. Blank when the two agree, which
#             is the normal case. It is here because the file name's tHHMM
#             token may follow either one, and C23 has to be able to tell a
#             real timestamp from an invented one.
#             Where a token-bearing file has no timestamp inside it at all, as
#             the PNG exports do, this was recovered once from the modification
#             time and is preserved verbatim from then on: a clone resets
#             mtimes, so reading it twice would give two different answers.
#   sha256    of the file as it stands. This is the integrity baseline.
#   caption   what the file shows, in one line.
# What is NOT here, and where it lives instead:
#   qr-survey.*        regenerated from the published URL, see MAINTENANCE.md
#   CONTACT-SHEET.jpg  generated from these rows, so listing it here would make
#                      the manifest describe its own output

Item 1 on the shelf: CORRETTORE PH PIU' GRANULARE, Lapi, 25 kg. Sodium carbonate, and the correct neutraliser for an acid spill.
Its label: sodium carbonate CAS 497-19-8, lot 13823, 400 to 600 g per 100 m3 per 0.1 pH, H319.
Item 2: NortemBio POOL pH+ INCREASER, 6.5 kg. A second and different pH raiser, about four times the Lapi rate for the same job.
Item 4: CORRETTORE PH MENO GRANULARE, Lapi, 8 kg. Sodium bisulfate, the hand-dosed pH minus.
Its label: sodium hydrogen sulfate CAS 7681-38-1, lot 6G16, PERICOLO, H318. It leaves about 2.15 times the sulphate of the acid drum for the same pH movement.
Item 3: CLORO GRANULARE 56% RAPIDO, Acquaverde, 5 kg. The only manual chlorine here, and the one that must never share a room with the acid drum.
Its label: sodium dichloroisocyanurate CAS 51580-86-0, UN 3077, and EUH031, contact with acids liberates a toxic gas.
Item 7: ANTIALGHE CONCENTRATO, Axton, 5 L. Quaternary ammonium at 4 percent, preventive and curative.
Its dosing panel: 2 L per 100 m3 initial, 0.5 L per 100 m3 weekly, produced 16/06/2026.
Its hazard panel: PERICOLO, H315, H318 serious eye damage, H410, and the two Italian poison centre numbers.
Item 8: FLOCCULANTE, Klep Piscina, 5 kg. Polyaluminium chloride, and the right tool for this pool's one filtration weakness.
Its label: curative 15 g per m3 then backwash every 4 to 5 hours, preventive 10 g per 10 m3 after every backwash, H319.
Item 6: RECUPERO, Controlchemi, 5 L and about a third full. Sodium bromide. A part-used bottle is evidence of chlorine lock at least once.
Its label: cod. 030323, the shock and maintenance rates, and the target pH of 7.5 to 7.7, which is above the 7.2 the TRi PRO holds.
Item 5: SVERNANTE CONCENTRATO, Controlchemi, 5 kg. A phosphonate scale inhibitor, and the most hazardous container on the shelf.
Its label: cod. 030321, UN 3265, professional use, 50 g per m3 at shutdown, PERICOLO for both skin and eyes.
Item 9: SALE PER PISCINE, Atisale POSEIDON, 25 kg. EN 16401 Quality A, no additives, sold specifically for electrolysis pools.

Item 10's datasheet: Italkali salgemma tablets, codice 546E, scheda 097. NaCl 99.4 percent minimum, tested to UNI EN 973 Grade A, with no line for iron or bromide because that standard does not ask for either.

Item 10's bag, from the retailer's product listing rather than the shelf: studio background, no EXIF, downloaded not shot. Front panel only, showing the UNI EN 973 Grade A seal and SPECIFICO PER ADDOLCITORI.
The 3D scan, glTF 2.0 binary: 4 progressive meshes, 1,290,227 triangles, 861k vertices, 4 JPEG textures. To scale in metres, sound for geometry, useless for counting anything thin.
A top-down density plot of every scan vertex between 0.35 and 1.80 m above the floor, at 380 pixels per metre. Red is the owner's tape, blue the wall planes the scan itself contains.
